A newline-only inline wrapper still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("Alpha<span style=\"white-space:pre\">\n</span>13", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
